description: This file contains unit tests for the JSON socket stream functionality within the Thunder project. It defines test classes, enums, and test cases that verify the behavior of JSON-based socket communication, including connection handling, message serialization, and synchronization mechanisms.

classes.name: Parameters
classes.description: Represents the parameters for socket stream commands, including speed, duration, command type, and settings.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: Represents a command with an ID, name, base address, trick flag, and associated parameters.

classes.name: JSONObjectFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating JSON command objects, managing a pool of Command instances.

classes.name: JSONConnector
classes.description: Template class managing JSON socket connections, handling message reception, sending, and connection state, with synchronization primitives.

methods.name: Received
methods.description: Handles incoming JSON elements, either submitting them if server socket or storing data if client.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Placeholder for sending JSON elements over the socket.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles state changes in the connection, notifying waiting threads when open.

methods.name: IsIdle
methods.description: Indicates whether the connector is idle.

methods.name: Retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves the received data and clears the buffer.
